notes: The TXR-2216 itemization lumps 11 work items into one 3,068.00 deduction with no sub-amounts, and the only vendor support is an estimate (qsr13057, 6/13/24) whose tenant total equals the billed amount. The line is categorized repairs_damage as the dominant work (patch/paint, doors, trim), but it also contains trash removal, bulbs, carpet cleaning and make-ready cleaning. The 115.00 owner power wash is excluded. All rent, late fees and the prorated June 1-3 charges were paid by 6/5/24. The lease is the original 5/7/22 to 5/4/23 term; renewals (rent up to 2,095 and 75 renewal fees on 6/1/23 and 5/1/24) are not in the folder, so month-to-month status at move-out is unknown. The sheet lease end equals the move-out date, 6/3/24. The 'collection charge of 35%' in the cover letter is hypothetical and not counted. The pet deposit 200 is the only cash deposit collected.
